draft.session_yaml:
session:
  name: earth-geo-tdrs
  display_name: Earth GEO TDRS slots
  description: Explicit GEO TDRS slot set with GEO gateway sites.
segments:
- id: geo
  source: nodalarc:space-node-sets/earth/geo/earth-geo-tdrs-6.yaml
- id: ground
  placement:
    from_site_set: nodalarc:site-sets/earth/geo/earth-geo-gateway-sites.yaml
  apply:
    scheduling:
      selection_policy:
        longest_remaining_pass:
          lookahead_horizon_ticks: 720
      handover_policy:
        hard_release: {}
      handover_mode: bbm
      mbb_overlap_ticks: 0
      mbb_reserve: 0
      handover_concurrency: one_at_a_time
      ranking_order:
      - service_priority
      - selection_score
      - satellite_ground_terminal_capacity
      - lex_pair
      mbb_preemption: 'off'
      successor_abort_policy: hard_release
      cross_tenant_displacement: 'off'
      bbm_acquire_timeout_ticks: 1
link_rules:
- id: geo_access
  topology:
    mode: visible_candidates
  endpoints:
  - select:
      all:
      - segment: ground
      - tag: geo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: access
      - medium: rf
      - mount: tdrs_ka_sa
    min_elevation_deg: 5
  - select:
      segment: geo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: access
      - medium: rf
      - mount: ka_sa
- id: geo_isl
  topology:
    mode: nearest_n
    n: 2
  endpoints:
  - select:
      segment: geo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: isl
      - medium: optical
  - select:
      segment: geo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: isl
      - medium: optical
simulation:
  candidate_limits:
    max_pairs_per_rule: 500
    max_pairs_per_tick: 2000
# Deliberate 10 s tick: GEO-only session, near-stationary geometry —
# finer steps add cost without adding fidelity. The system default is 1.
time:
  start_time: '2026-06-08T00:00:00Z'
  step_seconds: 10
  compression: 1
